4 اصرد السَّهْمَ , (S, M, L, K,) and الرُّمْحَ; (M;) and ↓ صَرَدَهُ ; (M, L, K;) He made the arrow, and the spear, or a part thereof, to pass through (S, M) the animal at which it was shot [or thrown]: (S:) or to penetrate so that its extremity passed through. (M, L, K.) [See صَرِدَ and صَارِدٌ.] ＝
-A2- See also 1, latter part.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
